summary.learningScope: Native cyclic-route recall and recurrent subroute mining. No shape names supervise memory. No novel whole-route composition, learned edit policy, learned defaults, or learned layout grammar yet.
summary.evidenceScope: Joint heading/actual-site consistency under one shared turn/reflection; lost calibration, reach extents, figure/ground and source ownership remain explicit unresolved projection. Admissible is not full metric reconstruction.
summary.baselines: Same admissible learned dictionary: canonical uniform ordering; exposure frequency alone; deterministic random ordering. Multi-stream and first-stream use the same frozen model. Test target agreement is a teacher preference, not correctness of every alternative.
summary.budget: 128 observed route slots; 128 topology faces; 512 joint-binding search states. Search cuts remain Open. Dataset is streamed; at most 32 detailed training audits retained.
